title: Deep Learning with PyTorch: tensors to reliable model releases
summary: A full36lesson PyTorch journey with depth comparable to the TensorFlow route. The sequence teaches idiomatic autograd, data loading, training, CNNs, sequences, transformers, diagnosis, checkpoints, performance and deployment with paired framework comparisons.

lessons.title: A bounded PyTorch investigation and framework comparison
lessons.outcome: A deep-learning investigation asks a model to predict a defined target from available inputs, then tests what evidence supports using that prediction.
lessons.lab: Use three training points(1, 2), (2, 4), (3, 6) and four untouched points(4, 8)..(7, 14); name one row as the prediction unit.
lessons.verification: 3 training rows, 4 holdout rows, one prediction per row. report says arithmetic/software checked; population reliability unestablished.

lessons.title: Tensors, devices, dtypes, strides and views
lessons.outcome: A PyTorch tensor has values plus metadata: shape, dtype, device, strides and gradient-tracking state.
lessons.lab: Create a2x3 float64 CPU tensor from values 0..5.
lessons.verification: shape(2, 3), stride(3, 1), CPU, float64. RuntimeError for incompatible trailing dimensions.

lessons.title: Linear modules, parameters and matrix contracts
lessons.outcome: A linear layer computes an affine transformation from input features to output features.
lessons.verification: outputs[[0], [2]], shape(2, 1). RuntimeError from incompatible matrix dimensions.

lessons.title: Loss functions, reductions and gradient scale
lessons.outcome: A loss is a numerical objective with a declared unit and denominator.
lessons.lab: Use residuals[1, -1, 2] against zero targets.
lessons.verification: squared entries 1, 1, 4; sum 6; mean 2. MAE 4/3; MSE 2.

lessons.title: Derivatives, requires_grad and finite-difference checks
lessons.outcome: A derivative measures local sensitivity: how much a function changes for a small input change.
lessons.lab: Differentiate (w-2)**2 at w=0 using autograd.grad.
lessons.verification: derivative -4; loss 4. all raise ValueError.

lessons.title: Autograd graphs, the chain rule and in-place hazards
lessons.outcome: Autograd follows the chain of tensor operations from a scalar objective back to its inputs.
lessons.lab: Use w=1, z=2*w, a=z*z and loss=(a-1)**2.
lessons.verification: z2, a4, loss 9, gradient 48. at new w=1.5, gradient -1 for (w-2)**2.

lessons.title: Leaf tensors, detach, no_grad and gradient accumulation
lessons.outcome: PyTorch distinguishes graph tracking from gradient storage.
lessons.lab: Create leaf w0 and intermediate 2 w, retain the intermediate gradient and backpropagate its sum.
lessons.verification: w leaf True; intermediate False; gradients 2 and 1. output still requires_grad True.

lessons.title: One optimizer step you can audit
lessons.outcome: One optimizer step is the smallest complete training experiment.
lessons.lab: Use float64 x1, 2, 3, y2x and scalar w0.
lessons.verification: mean squared loss 56/3. w.grad None; updated weight unchanged.

lessons.title: Batches, zero_grad and repeated updates
lessons.outcome: An epoch is a traversal of selected records; a batch is the set reduced before an update; an optimizer step changes parameters once.
lessons.lab: Partition IDs 1..6 into batches of 2.
lessons.verification: three batches[[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]. epoch mean 4, not 5.

lessons.title: Datasets, held-out families and leakage controls
lessons.outcome: A Dataset is an interface for retrieving observations, not a guarantee that the experiment is leakage-free.
lessons.lab: Create eight records with groups A, A, B, B, C, C, D, D and values 1, 3, 5, 7, 20, 22, 30, 32.
lessons.verification: length 8; item 0 has ID 0, group A, value 1. 16, 18, 26, 28.

lessons.title: nn.Module, registered parameters and explicit training loops
lessons.outcome: Annn.
lessons.lab: Build Scalar Model with weight 0 and buffer offset 0.
lessons.verification: one parameter weight; one buffer offset; both in state_dict. same weight object and one parameter.

lessons.title: Capstone: an auditable tiny PyTorch regressor
lessons.outcome: An auditable regressor combines data identity, a baseline, an explicit training loop and separate assessment.
lessons.lab: Use rows zero, e1, e2, e3, [1, 1, 1], [2, 1, 1] and target 2 a-b+c.
lessons.verification: targets 0, 2, -1, 1, 2, 4. disjoint IDs; holdout count 2; explicit limited scope.

lessons.title: Binary logits, BCEWithLogitsLoss and thresholds
lessons.outcome: A binary logit is an unrestricted score.
lessons.lab: Apply sigmoid to-2, 0, 2.
lessons.verification: middle probability.5 and strictly increasing values. 0 errors at.5 and 1 at.8.

lessons.title: CrossEntropyLoss, multiclass and multilabel contracts
lessons.outcome: Multiclass classification chooses exactly one outcome among mutually exclusive classes.
lessons.lab: Use one row of three zero logits and target class 1.
lessons.verification: cross entropy log 3. IndexError or RuntimeError identifying an invalid target.

lessons.title: Dataset, DataLoader, collation and reproducible sampling
lessons.outcome: Dataset defines how to retrieve an observation, while DataLoader defines batching, sampling and collation.
lessons.lab: Load five paired ID/value records with batch size 2 and no shuffle.
lessons.verification: sizes 2, 2, 1 and IDs 0..4 exactly once. ValueError before padding; token IDs must be nonnegative int64 integers.

lessons.title: Initialization, nonlinearities and gradient diagnostics
lessons.outcome: Nonlinearity changes which functions a network can represent.
lessons.lab: Use inputs 00, 01, 10, 11 and two rectified differences.
lessons.verification: outputs 0, 1, 1, 0. both.6; the function is absolute difference.

lessons.title: Dropout, regularization, train and eval modes
lessons.outcome: Regularization and training mode affect different parts of the experiment.
lessons.lab: Use weights 1, -2 and compute L1and squared L2sums.
lessons.verification: L1=3; squared L2=5. output still requires grad; backward gives ones.

lessons.title: BatchNorm, LayerNorm and stateful normalization
lessons.outcome: Normalization can introduce both state and cross-observation dependencies.
lessons.lab: Apply BatchNorm momentum.5 to rows 1, 3 and 3, 5.
lessons.verification: running mean 1, 2; batch counter 1. finite zeros with default affine initialization.

lessons.title: Convolutions, channel layouts and shared computation
lessons.outcome: Convolution applies a shared local kernel across spatial positions.
lessons.lab: Apply kernel 1, 0; 0, -1 to image 1..9 in 3 x3NCHW layout.
lessons.verification: output shape 1, 1, 2, 2; all values-4. 8trainable scalars.

lessons.title: Pooling, local augmentation and label invariants
lessons.outcome: Pooling reduces local spatial information.
lessons.lab: Pool patch 1, 3; 2, 4 with a2x2window.
lessons.verification: max 4; average 2.5. left->right->left.

lessons.title: Embeddings, padded sequences and recurrent models
lessons.outcome: A padded sequence contains real positions and artificial storage positions.
lessons.lab: Use IDs 2, 3, 0 and a fixed 4 x2table with zero padding row.
lessons.verification: embedding shape 1, 3, 2; mask True, True, False. RuntimeError for invalid length.

lessons.title: Attention, transformer masks and information boundaries
lessons.outcome: Attention forms weighted combinations of value vectors using query-key comparisons.
lessons.lab: Use zero 3-by-2 queries/keys and values 2, 0; 0, 2; 6, 6.
lessons.verification: outputs 2, 0; 1, 1; 8/3, 8/3. repeated evaluation matches.

lessons.title: Debugging custom loops, accumulation and clipping
lessons.outcome: A custom training loop can fail by disconnecting the graph, forgetting an update, reusing old gradients or applying an incorrect reduction.
lessons.lab: Detach (w-2)**2 before backward and inspect tracking.
lessons.verification: detached loss requires_grad False; backward raises RuntimeError. nonnegative and below 56/675.

lessons.title: Capstone: a small classifier with honest evaluation
lessons.outcome: A classifier capstone must connect the task definition to training and evaluation evidence.
lessons.lab: Use training x-2, -1, 1, 2 with labels 0, 0, 1, 1 and test x-3, 3.
lessons.verification: 4training records, 2test records. negative 0/1errors; positive 1/1.

lessons.title: Contrastive embeddings and negative sampling
lessons.outcome: Embedding objectives teach a representation to preserve selected relationships.
lessons.lab: Use anchor[1, 0], positive[1, 1], negative[0, 1].
lessons.verification: dots 1, 0; cosines 1/sqrt 2, 0. positive probability increases; argmax remains 0.

lessons.title: Custom modules, residual paths, buffers and autograd checks
lessons.outcome: Custom modules should make state ownership and differentiation explicit.
lessons.lab: Create a width 2 residual with zero kernel and scale buffer 1.
lessons.verification: output equals input; one parameter and one buffer. gradient 24.

lessons.title: Transfer learning, frozen layers and optimizer membership
lessons.outcome: Transfer learning reuses a representation while adapting a task-specific head.
lessons.lab: Create a bias-free 2-to-2identity Linear base and disable its parameter gradients.
lessons.verification: base output equals input; all base parameters frozen. base weight now changes.

lessons.title: Restartable training, optimizer state and RNG evidence
lessons.outcome: Restartable training requires the state that determines the next update, not merely weights that reproduce the current prediction.
lessons.lab: Take two Adam updates of a zero-weight linear model onx 1, 2 and y 2 x.
lessons.verification: optimizer step 2 and positive weight. directory absent; no distributed-loader claim.

lessons.title: Stable objectives, precision and mixed-precision boundaries
lessons.outcome: Numerical stability concerns how an equivalent mathematical expression behaves in a finite representation.
lessons.lab: Exponentiate float32 logits1000, 999 directly.
lessons.verification: both exponentials infinite. ValueError before loss evaluation.

lessons.title: Distributed gradients and accumulation semantics on CPU
lessons.outcome: Distributed and accumulated gradients should represent a declared global objective.
lessons.lab: Combine means 2, 6 with counts 1, 3.
lessons.verification: global mean 5; unweighted shard mean 4. empty shard contributes 0; global mean 5.

lessons.title: Profiling, torch.compile and honest performance measurement
lessons.outcome: Compilation and profiling answer different questions.
lessons.lab: Evaluatef(x)=x*x+1 at float32[1, 2].
lessons.verification: output[2, 5]. receipt does not claim universal speedup.

lessons.title: state_dict, torch.export and inference parity
lessons.outcome: A state dictionary stores named parameters and buffers, not the complete Python architecture.
lessons.lab: Set a 2-to-1 bias-free Linear weight to[2, -1] and predict rows 1, 2 and 3, 4.
lessons.verification: outputs 0, 2. three-row parity passes; temporary directory absent.

lessons.title: Inference mode, model contracts and bounded batching
lessons.outcome: Inference is a bounded function with an input and output contract.
lessons.lab: Use float32 CPU rows 1, 2 and 3, 4.
lessons.verification: outputs 0, 2 with shape(2, ). input unchanged.

lessons.title: Robustness, privacy and evidence beyond a score
lessons.outcome: A reliability report should preserve the conditions and denominators behind a score.
lessons.lab: Use groups A, A, B with truth 1, 1, 0 and prediction 1, 0, 0.
lessons.verification: A1/2errors; B0/1. card explicitly has no privacy guarantee.

lessons.title: Paired model comparisons and uncertainty
lessons.outcome: Model comparisons should preserve the pairing between predictions on the same held-out identities.
lessons.lab: Use truth a0, b1, c2 with A0, 2, 2 and B 1, 2, 3 in different dictionary order.
lessons.verification: paired squared-loss differences-1, 0, -1. test selection violates the declared boundary.

lessons.title: Capstone: release a small reproducible PyTorch model
lessons.outcome: A reproducible model release is a bundle of state, schema, data identity, execution evidence and limitations.
lessons.lab: Use train x1, 2, 3 and holdout 4, 5 with target 2 x and disjoint IDs.
lessons.verification: 3training and 2 holdout records. local checks True; production no-go; directory absent.
